scientific_integrity: The complete executable and recorded output reconstruct all faces, all matching incidences, acyclicity and both signed integral four-to-three boundary calculations; no floating-point or sampling is used.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite homotopy classification for the Lovász open-neighborhood complex of the 21-vertex triangular graph only; no assertion for larger triangular graphs, equivariant actions, or independent audit. Prior mod-two homology does not imply the new integral null-attaching maps. Residual risk of unindexed equivalent prior work.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional sphere-wedge homotopy of \(\mathcal N(T_7)\)
